title: Inland vessels - Cutter suction dredge components, Part 6: Cast spud cylinder - General requirements
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10854 (PART 6)) covers Inland vessels - Cutter suction dredge components, Part 6: Cast spud cylinder - General requirements. This Indian Standard was adopted by the Inland and Harbour Graft Sectional Committee had been approved by the Transport Engineering Division Council. This standard gives requirements for cutter suction dredge components. This standard has been based on the information supplied by Dredging Corporation of India, Visakhapatnam. This standard is being issued in the following parts: Part 1 Gutter Part 2 Suction Pipe Part 3 Ladders Part 4 Spuds Part 5 Cast spud point The committee responsible for the preparation of this standard is given at Annex A. In reporting the results of a test or analysis made in accordance with this standard, if the final value, observed or calculated, is to be rounded oflTj it shall be done in accordance with 'Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised )'.
